verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing docs explicitly state instant virtual card creation scoped to purpose (ad spend, contractors, single vendor) with per-card limits and spend controls, and community evidence corroborates real-world use of hundreds of purpose-scoped virtual cards with individual limits. missing for 10: no first-party API/CLI documentation snippet showing the actual card-creation endpoint/parameters in action, and no independent review specifically validating the 'scoped to a single vendor' use case beyond the marketing claim.
